name: My Little Guy
description: Parses your hand-formatted character sheet tables into live frontmatter on every edit, then gives you a full paginated widget view: Combat, Abilities/Saves/Senses, Skills, Actions, Inventory, Spells & Spell Slots, Speed & Defenses, Features & Traits, Proficiencies, Background, Notes, Creatures, and Level Up, with rests and hit dice in the pinned bar.
author: Glen
